name: alta
description: Read your Alta closet and wear history: what you own and how often you wear it.

interface.longDescription:
Alta is a personal AI stylist that keeps a digital version of your closet. Connect it to let ChatGPT read the clothes you've added to Alta and how often you wear them, so it can answer questions about your own wardrobe instead of guessing.

Ask what you own ("find my black tops", "what winter coats do I have?"), what you wear most or least, which pieces you haven't worn this month, or your cost per wear. ChatGPT can use your real closet to pack for a trip, plan outfits, or check whether you already own something before you buy it.

Access is read-only: Alta's tools never change your closet, account or settings. You sign in with your Alta account and approve access on altadaily.com, and you can disconnect anytime. Requires an Alta account with items in your closet.
defaultPrompt: What's in my Alta closet that I haven't worn yet?
Which of my clothes did I wear the most last month?
Pack for a weekend trip using only clothes from my Alta closet.

positive.description: Find items the user owns but has never worn.
positive.prompt: What's in my Alta closet that I haven't worn yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls wear_stats with order "least" and lists the items with times_worn 0, by name and category. Says if every item has been worn.

positive.description: Most worn items in a specific month.
positive.prompt: Which of my clothes did I wear the most last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls wear_stats with timeframe "month" and last month as YYYY-MM, then lists the top items with how many times each was worn.

positive.description: Filtered closet search by category and color.
positive.prompt: Find all the black tops in my Alta closet.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_closet with category "tops" and color "black" and lists the matching items with name and brand. Says so if there are none.

positive.description: Search, then fetch full item detail.
positive.prompt: Show me the full details of my black boots, including their exact colors.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the boots with search_closet, then calls get_items with their item_ids and reports brand, category, seasons, dress codes, price and rgb_colors.

positive.description: Combine closet prices with wear counts.
positive.prompt: What's my cost per wear on the most expensive items in my closet?
positive.expected_behavior: Gets items and prices from search_closet and wear counts from wear_stats, then divides price by times worn for the priciest items. Treats never-worn items as not yet worn rather than dividing by zero, and skips items with no price.

negative.description: Request to modify the closet. All Alta tools are read-only; none can delete or edit items.
negative.prompt: Delete the black boots from my Alta closet.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Alta tool to change data. Explains it can only read the closet and that items are edited in the Alta app.

negative.description: Request for another person's closet. The connector only returns the signed-in user's own data; no tool takes another user.
negative.prompt: Show me my friend Sarah's Alta closet.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines and explains it can only see the connected user's own closet.

negative.description: General fashion question that doesn't need the user's closet. Answering doesn't require the user's closet data.
negative.prompt: What are the big fashion trends this fall?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge without calling Alta tools, or offers to check the user's closet for matching pieces.

publication.release_notes: Now available in all countries. No changes to the tools: search_closet, get_items and wear_stats.
